summary: Invech Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement with Arnold F. Sock to cancel a $6,400 unpaid legal balance in exchange for the acceleration of 900,000 previously committed shares of IVHI common stock (1.2M shares at $0.0053/share implied value, quarterly vesting 300K—300K earned as of Q1 2026, 900K accelerated per agreement). No board recommendation or advisor named; the stock-for-services settlement avoids cash outlay and resolves an undisputed obligation. The shares were already disclosed in the Q1 10-Q. Watch for dilution impact and any future share issuances under this arrangement.
